neighbours.label: The set-up of a ranking or superlative: ' of' in 'one/three of the …' and ' first' in 'the/your first …'; the same nouns without a ranking (a/the + noun) stay lower. Plain prenominal adjectives also fire moderately.
fire: Oxford is one of the oldest universities in Europe.
She became the first woman to fly across the ocean.
This is one of the busiest stations in the city.
They signed their first contract with a record label.
Two of the biggest banks announced mergers today.
He won the first prize at the county fair.
The bridge is one of the longest in the world.
We celebrated our first anniversary in Rome.
quiet: Oxford has universities and colleges across the town.
She became a pilot and flew across the ocean.
This station is busy at rush hour in the city.
They signed a contract with a record label.
Banks announced mergers today after long talks.
He won a prize at the county fair.
The bridge crosses the river near the old mill.
We celebrated an anniversary in Rome.

notes: Card: ' of' x7 (one of the UK's most..., three of the numerous...), ' first' x7, ' famous' x3, ' several', ' three', ' largest'. Exploratory probe: 'one of the best' 0.78, 'the first coffee house' 0.68, 'your first office' 0.69, 'three of the largest' 0.39; but 'a large' 0.38 and 'a small' 0.44 also fire, so the near misses avoid prenominal adjectives.
